replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, honestly. My high neuroticism makes me worry a lot when facing complex numbers or formulas. The pressure to perform well is stressful, and sometimes I avoid touching math because it feels overwhelming and triggers my anxiety levels.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Not really, but if I did, I think I'd be cautious. My high conscientiousness means I prefer structured, reliable sources. Using AI for math could help with explanations, but I worry about accuracy and trust issues when dealing with sensitive academic topics.
